title: Deep tech punches above its weight
author: agam
hypothesis: Deep-tech topics (quantum, fusion, photonics, chips, batteries, gene editing) earn clearly more HN attention per story than the rest.
expect: If true, deep-tech stories should average at least 1.3x the points per story of all other stories, week by week on average (1.1x counts as weak, below 0.9x refutes it).
caveats: This tests traction on HN, not lead time over the mainstream. Ten weeks cannot show who was early.
Points are skewed: one hit story can move a week. Weekly means are shown, not medians.
Topic list is title keywords chosen in advance (scripts/terms.py); other deep-tech stories are missed.
